source_text: This resolution drew criticism from bioethicists for inadequately protecting non-consenting infants, as parental religious conviction may override disclosed perils, perpetuating a practice where empirical harm—evidenced by clustered infections tracing to individual mohels—outweighs unsubstantiated ritual claims. [90]
